name: Hume AI
tagline: Emotionally intelligent voice AI — speech-to-speech (EVI) and expressive TTS (Octave).
description: Hume builds voice AI tuned to emotional expression. Its Empathic Voice Interface (EVI) is a speech-to-speech system that reads vocal tone, handles interruptions and back-channeling, and can front any external LLM. Octave is its expressive text-to-speech model with voice design, cloning, and modulation.
insight: Founded by former Google AI researcher Alan Cowen; raised a $50M Series B in 2024 led by EQT Ventures.

modelSupport.notes: EVI pairs its empathic model with external LLMs of your choice.

edge: The voice API built around emotional expression — it reads vocal tone and turn-taking, not just words, for more natural-feeling conversations.
cons: Core EVI and Octave are closed-source
Smaller ecosystem than big TTS vendors
